$schema: NSDA Public Forum round timing — CORRECTED order (3 crossfires, rebuttals by 2nd speakers, grand crossfire after both summaries)
title: PFRoundSequence
prepTimeNote: 3:00 cumulative prep per team (NSDA standard 2025-2026). Used between speeches at a team's discretion; not a speech. Make configurable for non-NSDA tournaments.

sequence.label: First Crossfire
sequence.purpose: 1st speakers question each other; Pro (who spoke first) asks the first question

sequence.label: Pro Rebuttal
sequence.speaker: pro2
sequence.purpose: Pro 2nd speaker clashes with the Con case

sequence.label: Con Rebuttal
sequence.speaker: con2
sequence.purpose: Con 2nd speaker clashes with the Pro case

sequence.label: Second Crossfire
sequence.purpose: 2nd speakers question each other; Pro asks the first question

sequence.label: Grand Crossfire
sequence.purpose: All four debaters (seated) question/answer at will after the first question

sequence.label: Pro Final Focus
sequence.speaker: pro2
sequence.purpose: Impact calculus; persuasive close. NO new arguments allowed.

sequence.label: Con Final Focus
sequence.speaker: con2
sequence.purpose: Last speech of the round. Impact calculus; NO new arguments allowed.

correctionsToNaiveOrder: PF has only THREE crossfires (First after both Constructives, Second after both Rebuttals, Grand after both Summaries) — NOT a crossfire after every speech.
Rebuttals are delivered by the SECOND speakers (Pro-2, Con-2), not the first.
Summaries are delivered by the FIRST speakers (Pro-1, Con-1).
Grand Crossfire comes AFTER both Summaries, not between them.
Final Focus bars new arguments — impact weighing/persuasive close only.
